content.short: TokenScript is an open-source framework that lets token issuers enrich tokens with information, rules, and functionalities, embeddable in wallets and services.
content.description: TokenScript is a JavaScript/WebAssembly/XML framework designed to enhance a token's functionality, security, and usability across blockchain ecosystems. It enables token issuers and other trusted authorities to enrich a token with a comprehensive set of information, rules, and capabilities. With TokenScript, wallets and web services can securely and privately embed a token with all of its functions, both on-chain and off-chain, without requiring users or developers to understand the underlying smart contract.
content.meta: TokenScript is a JavaScript/WebAssembly/XML framework for token functionality and security. Discover TokenScript and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
